question: Add `events` to the free_tier.unit vocabulary, for a count of events, spans, log records or metric data points?
why: No existing unit fits: requests counts calls, and one batch request carries many events (Honeycomb's batch endpoint takes one or more events; PostHog's /batch has no limit on the events in a request); objects counts stored things. Honeycomb (20M events and 100M metrics data points a month) and PostHog (1M analytics events a month) use mixed and name the true unit in free_tier.notes. A store query finds ten records of unit mixed whose free-tier text names events, spans or data points: compute/mastra, compute/sentry, dev-services/better-stack, dev-services/datadog, dev-services/growthbook, dev-services/honeycomb, dev-services/launchdarkly, dev-services/posthog, dev-services/sentry and storage/comet-ml-artifact-dataset-management. The same records disagree on metered_on for an event count (object-count at Honeycomb and Datadog, request-count at PostHog and Sentry), so a matching metered_on term such as event-count may be wanted.
